title: dzkit rule
description: One rule, with every version it has had. Each version says when it applies and which sources back it.

valid_from.description: First day the version applies. null means it applied at least since the earliest source but the exact start is not recorded.

valid_to.description: Last day the version applies. null means still in force.

status.description: official: from an official text. confirmed: no official text is published, but real examples match. convention: standard practice.

data.description: The rule's values. Their shape is specific to each rule and documented in the rule file.
